What to expect on banquet night

Here's everything confirmed so far — we'll fill in the last few blanks as the date gets closer.

When

The closing banquet of the 2026 NCWSA National Championships, on Saturday, October 17, 2026 from 6:00–10:00 PM, with an afterparty following.

Where

Cal Expo, Building C — 1600 Exposition Blvd, Sacramento, CA 95815.

A full buffet dinner is included with every seat.

Parking

Free parking for every guest — no validation, no fee.

Seating will be assigned at the event

The Bar

Beer and wine will be available for purchase — guests 21 and older only, ID required.

Getting to Building C

Cal Expo has four buildings sharing one address, so the lot matters more than the street number. Enter through the Main Gate on Exposition Blvd & Heritage Way, then head for Lot C — it's the closest parking to Building C, right alongside Lot B.

Running early or want the full grounds map? Cal Expo's own directions page and facility brochure cover every gate, lot, and building on site.
